subtitle: The wrestling show continues between matches

body: WWF SmackDown! 2: Know Your Role is Yuke's PlayStation wrestling game, released in North America on 20 November 2000. It expands the first SmackDown! with a larger roster and a Season Mode that places matches within an ongoing wrestling programme. Familiar WWF performers enter a schedule of rivalries, alliances and backstage encounters rather than appearing only in isolated bouts. The player chooses a wrestler and works through that changing context, with the television presentation helping connect the action in the ring to the personalities whose conflicts make the next match matter.

Character creation lets the player assemble a wrestler's appearance and moves, while stable creation provides a way to organise groups. Those choices extend participation beyond selecting a famous performer from a menu. In the ring, the accessible controls favour quick exchanges and the spectacle of recognisable moves. Different match arrangements and backstage locations change the surroundings in which a rivalry can continue. The player can therefore approach the game as a succession of competitive bouts or as the construction of a wrestling personality whose actions become part of the season's developing show.

Know Your Role arrived only months after the first game and became one of the most successful wrestling releases of its generation, selling more than three million copies. Its substantial Season Mode also made loading times a recurring part of the experience. The next main SmackDown! moved to PlayStation 2 with Just Bring It. This entry captured the WWF's Attitude Era through its roster and the breadth of its wrestling programme, offering a console version of the attraction that extends beyond any single match: the sense that the next episode will continue a familiar, unruly world.
